rules.statement: The District Judge had jurisdiction to award damages for the period after the action was brought, even if the breach was continuous and neither party repudiated the contract.
rules.supporting_quote: There is, no doubt, considerable force in this contention; but, on the other hand, one party to a contract is not bound to give to the other unlimited time after a day named to do that which the other has contracted to do. There must be some point of time at which delay or neglect amounts to refusal.

meta.parties: Pless Pol v. Lady De Soysa Et Al
